entries.title: Check an automation before it runs
entries.body: A new automation is saved as a draft until you turn it on. Enable shows what it will do first: when it runs, its time zone and project, the exact prompt Firstmate gets, the next dates, what it sends and what happens if Firstmate is closed at that time. When you ask Firstmate for an automation and leave details open, or Firstmate sets up a repeating one on its own, it waits as a draft for you to check.

picture.alt: The check before an automation turns on, listing when it runs, its time zone, the prompt Firstmate gets and a Turn on button

entries.title: An automation's history shows what each run led to
entries.body: Each run in an automation's history now says whether Firstmate handled it, is still waiting, is trying again, or had it taken back, and links to the tasks and cards it led to. Pausing, changing or deleting an automation takes back a prompt Firstmate has not read yet, and an automation never piles up more than one waiting prompt.

picture.alt: An automation's history with runs marked retrying, handled, cancelled and sent, and a handled run linking to a task and a card

entries.title: Automation works from a computer that controls your Firstmate
entries.body: A computer that controls your Firstmate on another computer now has the Automation tab, panel and commands too, with the same automations. Changes you make there take effect on the computer where Firstmate lives, which is still the only one that runs them.

picture.alt: Settings on a computer that controls Firstmate, with an Automation tab listing three automations
